overview: This Senate resolution congratulates the College of Idaho Yotes for winning the 2025 men's basketball national championship of the National Association of Intercollegiate Athletics (NAIA), an association of mostly smaller colleges. The Yotes beat Oklahoma Wesleyan University 93-65 on March 25, 2025, finishing the season 35-2 for their third national title. The resolution recognizes the players, coaches, staff and fans, and sends copies to college leaders and the head coach. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on May 13, 2025.
for: Supporters say it honors a small college's national championship and the community that supported the team.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic: it does not change any law or spending.
